Once you uninstall a display language Windows cannot display text in that language. Any supported speech and handwriting recognizers will also be uninstalled.
Display languages allow Windows to display text in your chosen language and where supported recognize speech and handwriting.
You can go to Windows Update to download display languages online or you can browse your computer or network.

Launch Windows Update
Choose the Optional updates link to view, download and install display languages.

Browse computer or network
Locate and install display languages manually.
To install display languages, you must accept the license terms.
